regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Term Plan
variants: Bajaj Life eTouch II - Life Shield variant (base term cover, UIN 116N198V05)
key_benefits: Death Benefit — lump sum paid to nominee on death of the Life Assured
Terminal Illness (TI) Benefit — lump sum on diagnosis of terminal illness, up to Rs 2 Crores
Critical Illness rider benefit — lump sum on diagnosis of any of 60 covered critical illnesses, including women-specific conditions (breast, corpus uteri, cervix uteri, ovary, vulva, vagina)
Child Care rider benefit (optional) — 105% of total rider premiums paid plus a monthly income until the child turns 25, on death or ATPD of the Life Assured
Health Management Services worth up to Rs 36,500 p.a. (comprehensive health check-up, OPD consultations, pregnancy OPD wallet, emotional wellness, nutritionist)
riders_available: Bajaj Life New Critical Illness Benefit Rider - Comprehensive variant (Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider, UIN 116B058V01)
Bajaj Life Family Protect Rider - Child Care variant (Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider, UIN 116B056V01)

eligibility.policy_term: Illustrations use a 40-year policy term; full PT range not captured in this one-pager
eligibility.note: This is a women-focused packaging of Bajaj Life eTouch II - Life Shield variant (base term plan 116N198V05) bundled with the New Critical Illness Benefit Rider (116B058V01) and the Family Protect - Child Care Rider (116B056V01). eTouch II is also available standalone or with other riders. Eligibility boundary table not recovered from this one-pager.

key_terms.free_look_note: Not captured in this one-pager; standard 30 days expected (per the eTouch II base plan) — verify against policy document.
key_terms.grace_period: Not captured in this one-pager — verify against policy document.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not captured in this one-pager — verify against policy document.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: Pure term cover (Life Shield variant) — NO maturity benefit; no money is returned on survival.
key_terms.terminal_illness_note: Terminal Illness benefit is an acceleration of the death benefit, capped at Rs 2 Crores.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits per prevailing Section 10(10D) and Section 80C (under the old tax regime) of the Income Tax Act — subject to change; consult a tax advisor.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Risk Factors & Warning Statements (product/rider names do not indicate quality/future prospects/returns)
Statement that eTouch II is also available individually without/with other riders

claims_marketing_must_support: Any Critical Illness payout claim depends on the New Critical Illness Benefit Rider (116B058V01) being attached — it is a rider benefit, not base-plan cover; the '60 critical illnesses' figure is the Comprehensive variant.

Any 'monthly income for the child / child care' claim depends on the optional Family Protect - Child Care Rider (116B056V01) being chosen; income runs only until the child turns 25 and triggers on death or ATPD.
Terminal Illness benefit is an acceleration of (not additional to) the death benefit, capped at Rs 2 Crores.
Health Management Services value (up to Rs 36,500 p.a.) is an estimated average market price for assumed service frequencies, not a cash benefit.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as an investment, savings or money-back product — it is non-linked, non-participating pure term protection with NO maturity benefit.
Do NOT present rider benefits (critical illness, child care, health services) as base-plan guarantees without referencing the relevant rider and its UIN.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'bonus' language — there are no bonuses (non-par) and no maturity/return-of-premium on this variant.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws / old tax regime' caveat.
must_state: Base plan UIN 116N198V05 (Bajaj Life eTouch II - Life Shield variant) plus rider UINs 116B058V01 and 116B056V01 wherever those rider benefits are referenced

Full regulatory descriptor of the base term plan: 'A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Term Plan' (riders are 'Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider')
Standard disclaimer to read the sales brochure and policy document of base plan and riders before concluding a sale

gaps: 'Superwoman Term' is a marketing package over eTouch II - Life Shield (116N198V05) + two riders (116B058V01, 116B056V01); confirm whether 'Superwoman Term' has its own IRDAI filing or is purely a marketing bundle.
